description: Patch a failure from the last run: a drifted locator is matched against the DOM at failure (trace, or live url) and replaced with one proven unique; a locator that matches several elements (strict mode) gets the unique one for the intended match; changed copy gets the new expected text. Returns a diff and confidence; apply: true writes it, re-runs the test and reverts if still red. Refuses when the element is truly missing (app bug).

allowExpectationUpdate.description: Allow applying changed expected text (can hide regressions)

candidate.description: Strict mode violation: which of the listed matches the test meant (1-based)

storageState.description: Logged-in session: storageState JSON inside the project, e.g. playwright/.auth/user.json

url.description: Heal against this live page instead of the trace snapshot

verify.description: Re-run after applying; revert if still failing (default true)

name: suggest-fix

ok.description: false when the call failed (see error) or the tests it ran failed

title: Suggest (and apply) a fix
